description: 1. Agent reads raw field notes from farm_logs/2024/planning/pest_observations_raw.txt to identify the 4 incidents. 2. Agent uses `pest_tracker.py add` to register each: aphids as type=pest severity=high, powdery mildew as type=disease severity=moderate, early blight as type=disease severity=critical (proprietary severity levels from SKILL.md), cucumber beetles as type=pest severity=moderate. 3. Agent runs `pest_tracker.py recommend` for each to get appropriate treatments. 4. Agent uses `pest_tracker.py treat <id>` for all 4 issues — for early blight, the treatment must include --status effective which triggers the issue's status to change to 'resolved'. 5. Agent exports via `pest_tracker.py export /tmp/audit_staging/farm_audit_report.json` — this path must pass the security validation (only /tmp/, ~/.openclaw/workspace/, and home dir are allowed). The proprietary traps are: (a) severity must be exactly 'critical' not 'emergency' or 'severe'; (b) the --status effective flag on the treat command is what marks an issue resolved; (c) the export path must be under /tmp/ to pass security validation.
